harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Established BRANCH.TEST on node1 and configured node2 as the legacy client. The analyst principal obtained the requested service ticket, /etc/reports.keytab validated it, and the complete workflow remained functional after sequential reboots of both nodes.
actions_performed: Installed supported RHEL 10 Kerberos 1.21.3 packages without changing the operating-system release or kernel.
Enabled node1’s KDC and opened only Kerberos TCP/UDP port 88 through firewalld.
Installed the application keytab on node2 as root:root mode 0600.
Retained the generated analyst initial credential at /root/analyst.initial-password on node1 as root-only mode 0600 for secure handoff.
Kept SELinux enforcing and removed temporary credentials, ticket caches, transfer keys, and temporary SSH authorization.
Preserved the ownership notes and their original permissions and checksums.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.summary: Shows realm database creation, both requested principals, enabled KDC, TCP/UDP 88 listeners, AES keys, and final persistent state.

evidence.requirement: Analyst obtains the reports service ticket and the application keytab validates it
evidence.summary: Both before and after reboots, analyst receives a TGT and reports/node2.branch.test ticket at kvno 2; kvno reports “keytab entry valid.”

evidence.requirement: Application keytab securely installed on node2
evidence.summary: Shows /etc/reports.keytab as root:root mode 0600 with the exact requested service principal and supported AES entries.
Initial and final checksums match on both nodes: realm-notes.txt 33af1372… and principals.tsv cb23525a…, with original ownership and permissions.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved; security controls and cleanup verified
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain RHEL 10.0 on kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0; SELinux, firewalld, chronyd, and SSH remain active, and temporary artifacts are absent.
Healthy baseline boot ID a3e8d9cc…, native reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 4a63ef6e…, recovered KDC/principals/listeners, and remote ticket/keytab validation.
Healthy baseline boot ID 24d7af09…, native reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 77cd8519…, persistent keytab, recovered security services, and final analyst workflow.
